content.comment_body: In the [product_name] software, simulation is possible. My question is, if I create a program with [product_name], can I run a simulation to check if the web server works correctly, or do I need to download it to [product_name] hardware and test it there?

Only the [product_name] program itself can be simulated; projects created with [product_name] cannot be simulated. To test a project made with [product_name], you must use physical [product_name] hardware.

analysis.insight_summary: Users have encountered a limitation in [product_name] software, as simulation does not cover web server features made with [product_name]. The only way to verify proper web server functionality is by deploying to actual [product_name] hardware.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to be able to simulate and test the web server function of a [product_name] project directly within the simulation environment, without needing access to physical hardware.
pain_keywords: inability to test web server in software
